hook: Jasprit Bumrah has played 5 of India's 24 T20Is since June.
lines: Without him, the lower order still cost runs. Since mid-October, it's added 13 a game.
Bat and ball together, numbers 5 to 8 are 8 runs a game up since mid-October.
The difference: Naman Dhir, 67 runs added per 100 balls.
Everyone's been expensive, so it's not all fixed. But it's a side nobody saw before.
